title: A counterexample to Turau’s amnesiac flooding conjecture
scope: For each k ≥ 4, a connected non-bipartite graph on 6k vertices with radius floor(5k/2) floods in at most three rounds from k sources, violating Turau’s conjectured lower bound.

title: Inverse Z-polynomials through rank four
scope: Positive coefficients through the rank and log-concavity for matroids on finite ambient types of rank at most four. The unrestricted conjecture remains open here.

title: Strict inverse Z log-concavity for line-preserving projective restrictions
scope: In every rank, the inverse Z-polynomial of a finite projective geometry restricted to points retaining at least two on every line has positive coefficients through rank and strict log-concavity at every interior degree. The unrestricted conjecture is not settled.

title: Property P: the finite witness {1, 2}
scope: The set {1, 2} has Property P and its reciprocal sum is 3/2. This is not a search certificate or an upper bound.

title: Ordered spectral proximity forces adjacency rank at most five
scope: For any simple graph on 3n vertices, n ≥ 3, squared distance of its ordered adjacency spectrum to (2n, 0, …, 0, −n, −n) strictly below 2/3 forces real adjacency rank at most five. This answers Problem 21, not Conjecture 20.
